columns.<container>_cpu_percent: docker stats CPU percent, 100 = one core
columns.db_connections / db_active_queries: pg_stat_activity backends of the application database / those active
columns.db_longest_transaction_s: age of the oldest open transaction, s
columns.db_pool_active / db_pool_pending: Hikari connections in use / threads waiting
columns.db_transactions_committed / db_rows_*: cumulative pg_stat_database counters of the application database
columns.evidence_free_bytes / docker_free_bytes: free bytes on the evidence and Docker root filesystems
columns.heartbeat_age_s: seconds since the run's last heartbeat, database clock
columns.meter_localization_<outcome>: process-cumulative catalogue.localization.content count for that outcome, all kinds
columns.meter_provider_*: process-cumulative application meters since application start: requests (attempts), unsuccessful, retries, summed request time in s (converted from the base unit the management port declares), mapping failures
columns.probe_failures: probes that answered nothing in this sample; their columns are empty, never zero
columns.process_cpu_ratio: JVM process CPU usage, 0..1 of the whole container allowance
columns.progress_*: fields of the application's latest INFO progress line (at most one a minute); cumulative for the run
columns.run_status: synchronization_run.run_status read from PostgreSQL; empty until the run is identified
columns.sample_duration_s: time this sample took to collect, the harness's own observer overhead
columns.stop_requested: true once an operator requested the UC-013 stop
columns.timestamp_utc: sample time, host clock, UTC ISO-8601

emptyCell: unavailable: the probe failed or the source does not exist yet; never zero
estimated: arithmetic on measured values, labelled with its basis
lazyCounters: a counter registers on its first increment; when the same scrape lists the registered meter names and the counter (or its tag value) is absent, it reads 0, and the snapshot lists it under lazilyAbsentAsZero; a failed probe stays empty
measured: read from the durable run report, PostgreSQL, Docker or the application's meters
redaction: external text is redacted for credentials, tokens and e-mail addresses and truncated; Game identities are not kept
sampling: one row per interval; every value is a point reading, so a sampled maximum is a lower bound
schemaChanges: evidence keeps the schemaVersion it was collected with; report never rewrites older evidence and derives a re-analysis into another directory with --output-dir
timerUnits: timer totals are converted to seconds from the baseUnit each answer declares (milliseconds for the application's OTLP registry); an undeclared unit is unavailable
